data.description:
## Description

**What**: Delete the three skill directories (plugins/dso/skills/init/, plugins/dso/skills/architect-foundation/, plugins/dso/skills/generate-claude-md/). Update the marketplace registry (plugins/dso/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json or equivalent) to remove the three skill entries. Confirm /dso:init, /dso:architect-foundation, /dso:generate-claude-md no longer appear in `claude plugin list`.

**Why**: SC4 mandates these three skills are no longer user-invocable. With S2's orchestrator running and S1's tests passing GREEN, the underlying logic is now fully present in skills/onboarding/phases/ and the standalone skill directories are redundant.

**Scope**:
- IN: rm -rf the three skill directories; update marketplace registry; verify `claude plugin list` no longer shows them.
- OUT: Cross-reference cleanup in CLAUDE.md and other files (S5). /dso:doctor audit update (S7). Conditional-content decomposition (S4).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `claude plugin list` does not show /dso:init, /dso:architect-foundation, or /dso:generate-claude-md
  ← Satisfies: "The three previously-user-invocable skills no longer appear in skill listings and are removed from the marketplace skill registry."
- When this story is complete, `ls plugins/dso/skills/` does not show init, architect-foundation, or generate-claude-md subdirectories
  ← Satisfies: "their directories under plugins/dso/skills/ are absent."

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Marketplace registry update + directory deletion should land in a single commit so consumer state is consistent at every commit boundary.
- [Reliability] After deletion, run `claude plugin list` in-session as part of the verification step — do not rely on grep alone.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, /dso:init, /dso:architect-foundation, and /dso:generate-claude-md no longer exist as separate user-invocable skills
